privacyExplain.OWN_ONLY: Each staff member sees only their own assigned shifts on the schedule — they cannot see who else is working.
privacyExplain.SHIFT_TEAM: Staff see their own shifts plus the teammates working the same shift that day, but not the full roster.
privacyExplain.FULL_ROSTER: Every staff member can see the complete roster for all colleagues and shifts.

logicExplain.DYNAMIC_DURATION: A booking's end time is calculated automatically from the default duration set above (e.g. 90 minutes after the start time).
logicExplain.FIXED_SLOTS: Bookings use fixed, pre-defined time slots. Each reservation occupies the table for the default duration set above, starting from the slot's time.
logicExplain.MANUAL_AVAILABILITY: No automatic time-based conflict checking. A table only blocks new bookings while staff mark it Occupied on the Tables page — clearing it (marking it Available again) is what frees it up for the next booking, not the clock.
